observation.visible_scene: A sunny beach with turquoise water, white breaking waves, a band of wet sand, and a rocky headland in the distance on the right. A runner wearing a coral/red long-sleeve top, black shorts, black socks and red-and-yellow running shoes moves along the sand, seen from behind and slightly to one side; the runner's shadow lies on the sand to the left.
visible_changes: The runner's legs cycle continuously through a running gait: the two feet alternate between planted contact and lifted/extended swing positions, and the shadow shifts in step with the leg motion.

The camera framing gradually changes from a tight crop of the legs and shorts to a wider view that includes the torso and swinging arms, and by the last frames the neck/head begin to appear at the top edge.

The background composition drifts as the clip progresses: the rocky headland on the right becomes more fully visible and the sea/horizon rises to occupy more of the upper frame, consistent with a camera tracking the runner along the shoreline.
Waves keep breaking along the waterline throughout the segment.
outside_clip_unknowns: The start and end of the run: the gait is already underway in the first frame and continues past the last, so no onset or completion is shown.
The runner's face, full upper body, and anything above the head are outside the crop.
The mechanism of the framing change (zoom-out, tilt-up, or camera repositioning) is not directly observable.
uncertain_details: Exact running direction relative to the world versus the camera: the runner stays roughly centered while the background shifts, so it is unclear whether the camera pans, tracks, or zooms.
Whether a true airborne flight phase occurs in every stride (some frames show both feet close to the sand).
